# Ventic — llms.txt
# See https://llmstxt.org/ — helps LLMs discover and cite your site correctly.

> Ventic è uno stack tecnologico chiavi in mano per creare, gestire e configurare LLM privati. Gira sulle tue GPU — dati in UE o US — con endpoint compatibile OpenAI e Anthropic, motore di inferenza ottimizzato (vLLM, SGLang) e pannello Admin multi-tenant. Alternativa a subscription frontier e pagamento a token: licenza BYOH €69,90/mese o PaaS da 1 €/h, mai a token.

# Primary
- [Ventic — Home](https://ventic.it/): LLM privati su GPU dedicate, endpoint OpenAI/Anthropic, BYOH e PaaS, overlay cifrato, scaling automatico.
- [Ventic — Home (EN)](https://ventic.it/en/): Private LLMs on dedicated GPUs, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible, data in EU/US.
- [Prezzi e confronto](https://ventic.it/pricing/): BYOH vs PaaS, pacchetti Ventic 16/64, matrice confronto vs provider.
- [Pricing (EN)](https://ventic.it/en/pricing/): Ventic vs alternatives, package comparison, per-user cost.
- [Pannello Admin](https://ventic.it/admin-panel/): Utenti, ruoli RBAC, modelli, telemetria, white label.
- [Admin Panel (EN)](https://ventic.it/en/admin-panel/): Users, RBAC, models, telemetry, white label, self-service.
